test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which word is closest in meaning to dupe?

He had come prepared to dupe the public with his elaborate setup.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2, i.e., Deceive**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"dupe"** means to trick or deceive someone into believing something false. (धोखा देना)
 
 
• **Example:** He managed to dupe his friend into lending him money by making false promises.
 
 
• The meaning of the word **"deceive"** is to cause someone to believe something that is not true, typically to gain a personal advantage. (छल करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The con artist deceived the elderly couple into buying a fake pain
